result.title: Learning From Static Context in Federated Time Series Forecasting
result.comment: 4th IEEE International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
result.summary: Time series forecasting is shifting from locally trained, per-series models to global models trained across many heterogeneous series, which requires learning what sets the series apart. When the raw data cannot be centralized, such a global model is trained with federated learning (FL), one client per data owner. State-of-the-art forecasters such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) tell series apart through a static input that describes each series and does not change over time. In the special case of a federated setting where each client holds a single series, this static input is constant within each client and varies only across clients. We ask whether a federated TFT can learn from it. Per-batch FedAdam, which aggregates gradients after every batch, uses the static input almost as well as central training, whereas communication-efficient schemes with local epochs (FedAvg, FedAdam+Prox) extract far less from it and gain nothing significant on either application dataset. At the same local computation, an Adam-compatible SCAFFOLD keeps the static pathway responsive on wind power and gains significantly there. On building energy its error still drops, but the static pathway falls silent, so drift and communication frequency cannot be fully separated as the cause. Only per-batch FedAdam matches or beats the per-client local models across all datasets. We confirm the effect on building-energy meter data, a wind-power dataset, and a controlled synthetic dataset. The loss is not specific to the TFT: on the synthetic and the wind data two further architectures with different static-conditioning mechanisms show it as well.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察联邦学习下的全局时间序列预测模型能否真正利用描述单条序列的静态输入，比较逐批 FedAdam、FedAvg、FedAdam+Prox 与 SCAFFOLD 在建筑能耗、风电及合成数据上的差异，并用另外两种静态条件架构复核该现象。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「静态条件通路是否被实际使用、何时失效（static pathway falls silent）」的诊断思路，可能可供核查 VLM 推理中视觉或静态条件信息是否被内部状态真正利用，即视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题。
